behaviorAndSourceAudit.interpretation: Frozen V5 old-development 8-seed diagnosis only. D/T benefit is concentrated in the advanced-opponent lineup. K net loss does not establish a single causal refusal/kong explanation. Conditional module effects may interact. No new game, seed, cap8, external source, or formal acceptance was introduced.

limitations: Eight repeatedly spent development seed clusters; all 72 strata are exploratory and unadjusted.
D improvement is concentrated in the advanced lineup; initial and teacher lineup means are negative.
Whole-game income differences and first-action groups are not single-action optimality labels.
Initial and advanced references share one source; expert level remains unestablished.
Active workspace includes later isolated cap8 work; executed V5 snapshots remain 82/82 byte identical.
All-five-policy forty-spent-seed follow-up separately predeclared; no new formal holdout started.
